examples.en: My grandfather was diagnosed with liver cancer.
Liver cancer shows almost no symptoms in the early stage.

examples.ko: 간암 수술을 받은 환자가 잘 회복하고 있어요.
examples.en: The patient who had liver cancer surgery is recovering well.

examples.ko: 의사가 간암 검사를 받아 보라고 했어요.
examples.en: The doctor told me to get tested for liver cancer.

examples.ko: 간암을 일찍 찾으려면 정기 검진이 중요해요.
examples.en: Regular checkups are important to find liver cancer early.

examples.ko: 뉴스에서 간암 치료법이 새로 나왔다고 해요.
examples.en: The news says a new treatment for liver cancer has appeared.

explain: 몸의 부위 뒤에 '암'을 붙이면 병 이름이 돼요. '위암', '폐암', '대장암'처럼요. 보통 '간암에 걸리다', '간암 진단을 받다'로 말하고, 무거운 병이라 가볍게 농담하는 말에는 쓰지 않아요.

phrases.en: My uncle came down with liver cancer.
phrases.nuance_ko: 병에 걸렸다고 말할 때 쓰는 가장 기본적인 표현이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: The most basic way to say someone has caught an illness.

phrases.example: 간암 진단을 받고 바로 치료를 시작했어요.
phrases.en: After the liver cancer diagnosis, treatment started right away.
phrases.nuance_ko: 병원에서 병이 있다고 확인받은 것을 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: Refers to the doctor confirming the disease.

phrases.en: This hospital has many liver cancer patients.
phrases.nuance_ko: 병을 앓고 있는 사람을 부를 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used to call a person who has the disease.

explain_en: Adding '암' (cancer) after an organ name makes a disease name, as in '위암', '폐암', '대장암'. People say '간암에 걸리다' (get liver cancer) or '간암 진단을 받다', and the word is not used lightly in jokes.

examples.en: In a dark place, your pupils get bigger.
The doctor checked my pupils with a light.
When you are surprised, your pupils suddenly shake.
A cat's pupils get narrow in bright places.
When the bright light shone, my pupils got smaller.

examples.ko: 검사 전에 동공 확대 약을 눈에 넣었어요.
examples.en: Before the exam, I put pupil-dilating drops in my eyes.

explain: 눈 한가운데 검은 부분이에요. 일상에서 '눈동자'를 훨씬 많이 쓰고, '동공'은 병원이나 과학 설명에서 나와요. '동공 지진'은 놀라서 눈이 흔들리는 모습을 장난스럽게 부르는 인터넷 말이에요.

phrases.en: In bright places, the pupils get smaller.
phrases.nuance_ko: '동공이 커지다'의 반대 쓰임이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: The opposite of 동공이 커지다.

phrases.en: My eyes are brown.
phrases.nuance_ko: 일상에서는 '동공'보다 '눈동자'를 훨씬 많이 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: In daily life, 눈동자 is used far more than 동공.

phrases.en: The doctor checked the pupil reaction.
phrases.nuance_ko: 병원에서 눈의 상태를 볼 때 쓰는 말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used in hospitals when checking the state of the eyes.

explain_en: It is the dark center of the eye. In daily life '눈동자' is far more common; '동공' belongs to hospitals and science. '동공 지진' is a playful internet phrase for eyes trembling in shock.

examples.ko: 과학 시간에 디엔에이 구조를 그려 봤어요.
examples.en: In science class, we drew the structure of DNA.
Parents and children have similar DNA.
Twins have almost identical DNA.
The researchers are analyzing the plant's DNA.
I learned that DNA is like a blueprint of the body.
We confirmed the family relationship through a DNA test.

explain: 글로 쓸 때는 'DNA'라고 영어로 쓰는 일이 많고, 읽을 때는 '디엔에이'라고 해요. '유전자'는 DNA 안의 정보 부분이라 완전히 같은 말은 아니에요. '우리 회사의 DNA'처럼 타고난 특징을 비유로 말하기도 해요.

phrases.en: I had a DNA test at the hospital.
phrases.nuance_ko: '검사'와 함께 쓰는 가장 흔한 짝말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: The most common collocation, with 검사 (test).

phrases.en: Identical twins have the same DNA.
phrases.nuance_ko: 조사 '가'와 형용사로 비교하거나 설명할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: With the particle 가 and an adjective to compare or explain.

phrases.en: The police examined the DNA at the scene.
phrases.nuance_ko: 뉴스나 사건 이야기에서 자주 쓰는 표현이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A phrase often heard in news and crime stories.

explain_en: In writing it is often spelled 'DNA' in English letters, and it is read aloud as '디엔에이'. '유전자' (gene) refers to an information part within DNA, so they are not exactly the same word. It is also used figuratively, as in '우리 회사의 DNA', for an inborn trait.

examples.en: If you don't sleep, your immunity drops.
I exercise every day to boost my immunity.

examples.ko: 아이들은 면역력이 약해서 감기에 잘 걸려요.
examples.en: Children have weak immunity, so they catch colds easily.
What foods are good for immunity?
I heard that stress weakens immunity too.
Grandmother has weak immunity, so she wears a mask.

explain: 몸이 병균을 이겨 내는 힘이에요. 한국에서는 건강 이야기에 자주 나와서 '면역력이 떨어지다/높이다/강하다'로 써요. 단순히 '체력'은 몸이 힘을 내는 능력이라 다르게 말해요.

phrases.example: 아이는 면역력이 약해서 감기에 자주 걸려요.
phrases.en: Children have weak immunity, so they catch colds often.
phrases.nuance_ko: 병에 잘 걸리는 상태를 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when someone gets sick easily.

phrases.example: 면역력을 기르려고 잘 먹고 잘 자요.
phrases.en: I eat well and sleep well to build up my immunity.
phrases.nuance_ko: 건강한 습관으로 몸의 힘을 키울 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when building up your body's strength through healthy habits.

phrases.example: 저는 면역력이 강해서 잘 안 아파요.
phrases.en: I have strong immunity, so I rarely get sick.
phrases.nuance_ko: 병균을 잘 이겨 내는 사람을 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used for someone who fights off germs well.

explain_en: 면역력 is the body's power to fight off germs, and it comes up constantly in Korean health talk: 면역력이 떨어지다, 면역력을 높이다. 체력 is different; it is physical stamina.

examples.en: My sister gave birth at the hospital yesterday.
The delivery took a long time, so the family worried.
This hospital has a new delivery room.
After childbirth you need to rest well.

examples.ko: 자연 분만을 할지 수술을 할지 의사와 이야기했어요.
examples.en: I talked to the doctor about natural delivery or surgery.
The due date is next week.

explain: 분만은 아기를 낳는 일을 병원이나 의학 쪽에서 말할 때 써요. 일상에서는 '아기를 낳다', '출산'이 더 흔해요. '분만실', '자연 분만'처럼 합쳐서 자주 써요.

phrases.en: My wife has just gone into the delivery room.
phrases.nuance_ko: 분만을 하는 병원의 방을 가리키는 합친 말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A compound word for the hospital room where childbirth takes place.

phrases.en: I gave birth to my baby naturally.
phrases.nuance_ko: 수술하지 않고 낳는 방법을 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used for giving birth without surgery.

phrases.en: My due date is next month.
phrases.nuance_ko: 분만보다 일상에서 더 흔하게 쓰는 말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A word used more commonly in daily life than 분만.

explain_en: 분만 is the medical term for giving birth. In daily talk 아기를 낳다 or 출산 is more common. It appears in compounds like 분만실 (delivery room) and 자연 분만 (natural birth).

examples.en: There is still no cure for this disease.
A new treatment drug has been developed.
The pharmacist recommended a headache medicine.
A few days after taking the medicine, I got better.
The research team is working on a cancer drug.
Be sure to read about the side effects of the medicine.

explain: 병을 고치는 약은 '치료제', 병을 막는 약이나 주사는 '예방약'이에요. 약 이름 끝에 '-제'가 붙는 말은 진통제, 소화제처럼 많아요.

phrases.en: A new cancer drug has come out.
phrases.nuance_ko: 병 이름을 앞에 붙여 그 병을 고치는 약을 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: Put a disease name before it to mean the drug that treats it.

phrases.en: The research team developed a treatment.
phrases.nuance_ko: 새 약을 만들어 낼 때 자주 같이 쓰는 말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A frequent pairing when a new drug is created.

phrases.en: This is not a cure but a preventive medicine.
phrases.nuance_ko: 병을 막는 약이라서 '치료제'와 구별해요.
phrases.nuance_en: A drug that prevents illness, so it is distinguished from 치료제.

explain_en: A drug that treats a disease is a '치료제'; one that prevents it is an '예방약'. Many drug names end in '-제', such as '진통제' (painkiller) and '소화제' (digestive aid).

examples.ko: 약 투여는 의사의 지시에 따라야 해요.
examples.en: Taking medication must follow the doctor's instructions.
The fever went down after the dose was given.

examples.ko: 주사 투여 시간은 아침 아홉 시예요.
examples.en: The injection time is nine in the morning.
For children, the dosage must be reduced.

examples.ko: 약의 투여가 끝나면 병원에 다시 오세요.
examples.en: When the course of medication is over, come back to the hospital.
They decided to stop the medication and watch the condition.

explain: 병원에서 약이나 주사를 환자에게 주는 일을 말할 때 써요. 환자가 스스로 약을 먹는 일은 '복용'이라고 하고, '투여'는 주는 쪽에서 보는 말이에요. 일상 대화보다 병원, 약 설명서, 뉴스에서 주로 나와요.

phrases.en: The dose of the medicine depends on body weight.
phrases.nuance_ko: 한 번에 주는 약의 양을 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used for the amount of medicine given at one time.

phrases.example: 약 설명서에 투여 방법이 적혀 있어요.
phrases.en: The administration method is written in the medicine's instructions.
phrases.nuance_ko: 주사나 먹는 약처럼 약을 주는 방식을 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used for how a medicine is given, such as by injection or by mouth.

phrases.en: Before the medicine is given, we check for allergies.
phrases.nuance_ko: 약을 주기 전의 시간을 말하며 병원 안내에 자주 나와요.
phrases.nuance_en: Refers to the time before the medicine is given and often appears in hospital notices.

explain_en: It describes giving a drug or injection to a patient, seen from the giver's side. When patients take medicine themselves, Koreans say 복용. You mostly meet 투여 in hospitals, drug leaflets and news rather than in everyday talk.

examples.ko: 할아버지는 몇 년 전에 파킨슨병 진단을 받으셨어요.
examples.en: My grandfather was diagnosed with Parkinson's disease a few years ago.

examples.ko: 파킨슨병은 손이 떨리는 증상으로 시작하기도 해요.
examples.en: Parkinson's disease can start with a trembling hand.
The news introduced a new treatment for Parkinson's disease.

examples.ko: 파킨슨병 환자를 돕는 운동 모임에 참여하고 있어요.
examples.en: I take part in an exercise group that helps people with Parkinson's disease.

examples.ko: 유명한 배우가 파킨슨병과 싸우고 있다고 해요.
examples.en: They say a famous actor is fighting Parkinson's disease.

examples.ko: 파킨슨병에 걸리면 걸음이 느려질 수 있어요.
examples.en: If you get Parkinson's disease, your walking can slow down.

explain: '파킨슨병'은 이 병을 처음 자세히 설명한 의사 제임스 파킨슨의 이름에서 왔어요. 손 떨림, 몸이 굳음, 느린 움직임이 대표적인 증상이에요. '파킨슨병에 걸리다', '파킨슨병 진단을 받다'처럼 써요.

phrases.en: There is a group that helps people with Parkinson's disease.
phrases.nuance_ko: 병에 걸린 사람을 말할 때 '환자'를 붙여요.
phrases.nuance_en: Add '환자' to talk about a person who has the disease.

phrases.en: The symptoms of Parkinson's disease got a little worse.
phrases.nuance_ko: 병의 겉으로 나타나는 모습을 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used for the visible signs of the disease.

phrases.example: 파킨슨병 치료를 위해 매일 약을 먹어요.
phrases.en: I take medicine every day for Parkinson's treatment.
phrases.nuance_ko: 병을 낫게 하거나 관리하는 일을 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used for treating or managing the disease.

explain_en: 파킨슨병 is named after the doctor James Parkinson, who described it in detail. Trembling hands, stiffness, and slow movement are typical symptoms. It goes with phrases like 파킨슨병에 걸리다 and 파킨슨병 진단을 받다.
